data.long_meaning: The name Raeann is derived from the Greek name 'Rhea', meaning 'flowing river', and the Hebrew name 'Ann', meaning 'grace'. In the Bible, the name Ann appears in various contexts, including as a variant of Hannah, the mother of the prophet Samuel. The name Raeann could be interpreted as a little shepherdess, or one who tends to the divine flow of life.

in_hebrew.name: רענה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Raeann (רענה) can be broken down into two parts: 'רע' (ra') which means 'mountain' or 'exalted' and 'נה' (nan) which means 'God'. Together, the name Raeann means 'mountain of God' or 'exalted God'.

in_greek.name: Ραιαννη
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Raeann (Ραιαννη) is derived from the Greek words 'ραια' (raia) meaning 'grace, mercy, compassion' and 'ννη' (nnē) which is a diminutive suffix. The name Raeann in Greek can be interpreted as 'little one of grace, mercy, or compassion'.

in_latin.name: Raeanna
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Raeann (Raeanna) is derived from the Latin words 'rae' (maiden, woman) and 'anna' (flourishing). The name Raeann in Latin can be interpreted as 'maiden or woman who flourishes'.

in_english.name: Raeann
in_english.long_meaning: The English name Raeann is derived from the Old English words 'rae' (meadow, pasture) and 'an' (one). The name Raeann can be interpreted as 'meadow or pasture of one' or 'joy'.
